_about: The club best and fairest, by its real name, for each of the 18 clubs that exist in the real league. P-54 (director, 2026-10-18). Each entry names the page its wording was checked against (English Wikipedia, read 2026-10-18; each page opens by naming the club and the award). A club not listed here (Tasmania, Canberra, a Forge club) keeps the plain 'Best and fairest'. Presentation only: nothing here is read by the match.

CAR.name: John Nicholls Medal
CAR.note: Formerly the Robert Reynolds Trophy, 1934 to 2003.

COL.name: Copeland Trophy
COL.note: The club calls it a Trophy (E. W. Copeland Trophy), not a medal.

ESS.name: Crichton Medal
ESS.note: Officially the W. S. Crichton Medal since 1959 or 1960; 'Crichton Medal' is the common name.

GCS.name: Club Champion
GCS.note: Gold Coast has no named medal: the award is the Gold Coast Suns Club Champion.

MEL.name: Keith "Bluey" Truscott Medal
MEL.note: Wikipedia titles the page 'Trophy'; the award is widely written 'Medal' and its winners 'Keith "Bluey" Truscott Medallists' (Melbourne Football Club article, Aaron Davey 2009). The director's wording, 'Medal', is used.

STK.name: Trevor Barker Award
STK.note: An award, not a medal (renamed for Trevor Barker).
